lines: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，
好叫我们得着智慧的心。
So give us knowledge of the number of our days
that we may get a heart of wisdom.
在你看来，千年如已过的昨日，
又如夜间的一更。
For to you a thousand years are no more than yesterday when it is past
and like a watch in the night.
因他要为你吩咐他的使者，
在你行的一切道路上保护你。
For he will give you into the care of his angels to keep you wherever you go.
神说：因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他；因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。
他若求告我，我就应允他；他在急难中，我要与他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊贵。
我要使他足享长寿，将我的救恩显明给他。
Because he has given me his love, I will take him out of danger: I will put him in a place of honour, because he has kept my name in his heart.
When his cry comes up to me, I will give him an answer: I will be with him in trouble; I will make him free from danger and give him honour.
With long life will he be rewarded; and I will let him see my salvation.
大龙就是那古蛇，
名叫魔鬼，又叫撒但，
是迷惑普天下的。牠被摔在地上，
牠的使者也一同被摔下去。
And the great dragon was forced down
the old snake
who is named the Evil One and Satan
by whom all the earth is turned from the right way; he was forced down to the earth
and his angels were forced down with him.
在他衣服和大腿上有名写着说：「万王之王，
万主之主。」
And on his robe and on his leg is a name
KING OF KINGS
AND LORD OF LORDS.
然而有一件事我要责备你，
就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。
But I have this against you
that you are turned away from your first love.
然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。
所以，应当回想你是从那里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，我就临到你那里，把你的灯台从原处挪去。
But I have this against you, that you are turned away from your first love.
So keep in mind where you were at first, and be changed in heart and do the first works; or I will come to you, and will take away your light from its place, if your hearts are not changed.
所以，应当回想你是从那里坠落的，
并要悔改，行起初所行的事。你若不悔改，
我就临到你那里，
把你的灯台从原处挪去。
So keep in mind where you were at first
and be changed in heart and do the first works; or I will come to you
and will take away your light from its place
if your hearts are not changed.
在头一次复活有分的有福了，
圣洁了！第二次的死在他们身上没有权柄。他们必作神和基督的祭司，
并要与基督一同作王一千年。
Happy and holy is he who has a part in this first coming: over these the second death has no authority
but they will be priests of God and of Christ
and will be ruling with him a thousand years.
我又看见一个新天新地；
因为先前的天地已经过去了，
海也不再有了。
And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were gone; and there was no more sea.
我又看见且听见，
宝座与活物并长老的周围有许多天使的声音；
他们的数目有千千万万，
And I saw
and there came to my ears the sound of a great number of angels round about the high seat and the beasts and the rulers; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand
and thousands of thousands;
我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里，
和天地间一切所有被造之物，
都说：但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权势都归给坐宝座的和羔羊，
直到永永远远！
And to my ears came the voice of everything in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea
and of all things which are in them
saying
To him who is seated on the high seat
and to the Lamb
may blessing and honour and glory and power be given for ever and ever.
这样，我在你们中间，
因你与我彼此的信心，
就可以同得安慰。
That is to say
that all of us may be comforted together by the faith which is in you and in me.
你若口里认耶稣为主，
心里信神叫他从死里复活，
就必得救。
Because
if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord
and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead
you will have salvation:
你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信神叫他从死里复活，就必得救。
因为人心里相信，就可以称义；口里承认，就可以得救。
Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:
For with the heart man has faith to get righteousness, and with the mouth he says that Jesus is Lord to get salvation.
所以弟兄们，我以神的慈悲劝你们，将身体献上，当作活祭，是圣洁的，是神所喜悦的；你们如此事奉乃是理所当然的。
不要效法这个世界，只要心意更新而变化，叫你们察验何为神的善良、纯全、可喜悦的旨意。

For this reason I make request to you, brothers, by the mercies of God, that you will give your bodies as a living offering, holy, pleasing to God, which is the worship it is right for you to give him.
And let not your behaviour be like that of this world, but be changed and made new in mind, so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.
爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；
恭敬人，要彼此推让。
Be kind to one another with a brother's love
putting others before yourselves in honour;
在指望中要喜乐，
在患难中要忍耐，
祷告要恒切。
Being glad in hope
quiet in trouble
at all times given to prayer
与喜乐的人要同乐；
与哀哭的人要同哭。
Take part in the joy of those who are glad
and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.
